SAMPLE SOFTWARE SERVICES AGREEMENT
This agreement is entered into as of August 1, 2026 between Sample Customer and Sample
Provider.
1. SERVICES. Provider will deliver the software services described in the attached
Statement of Work. Customer will provide reasonable access to its systems and data
needed for delivery.
2. FEES AND PAYMENT. Customer will pay the fees listed in the Statement of Work within
30 days after invoice. Late payments accrue interest at 1.5 percent per month.
3. TERM AND TERMINATION. The term begins on the effective date and continues for 12
months. Either party may terminate for convenience with 90 days written notice.
Provider may terminate immediately if Customer breaches payment obligations.
4. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY. Provider retains all rights in its software, tools, and
preexisting materials. Customer receives a limited license to use the deliverables
during the term.

--- Page 2 ---
5. CONFIDENTIALITY. Each party will protect the other's confidential information using
reasonable care and will not disclose it without prior written consent.
6. WARRANTIES. Provider warrants that the services will be performed in a professional
manner. Customer warrants that it has authority to enter this agreement.
7. DISCLAIMER. Except as stated in this agreement, all services and deliverables are
provided as is without warranties of any kind.
8. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY. Neither party will be liable for indirect, incidental,
special, or consequential damages. Each party's total liability is limited to fees
paid in the prior 12 months.
9. INDEMNIFICATION. Provider will indemnify Customer against third party claims
alleging that the deliverables infringe intellectual property rights. Customer will
indemnify Provider against claims arising from Customer data.
10. DATA PROTECTION. Each party will process personal data in accordance with
applicable law and maintain reasonable administrative, technical, and physical
safeguards.

--- Page 3 ---
11. GOVERNING LAW. This agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Delaware
without regard to conflict of law rules.
12. DISPUTE RESOLUTION. The parties will first attempt to resolve disputes through
good faith negotiation. Unresolved disputes will be submitted to binding arbitration
in Wilmington, Delaware.
13. ASSIGNMENT. Neither party may assign this agreement without the other party's
prior written consent, except to an affiliate or in connection with a merger or sale
of substantially all assets.
14. FORCE MAJEURE. Neither party will be liable for delays caused by events beyond its
reasonable control.
15. ENTIRE AGREEMENT. This agreement constitutes the entire understanding and
supersedes all prior agreements.
16. SIGNATURES. The parties execute this agreement by their authorized
representatives.
IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have signed this agreement as of the date first
written above.

This agreement is entered into as of August 1, 2026 between Sample Customer and Sample

1. SERVICES. Provider will deliver the software services described in the attached

needed for delivery.
2. FEES AND PAYMENT. Customer will pay the fees listed in the Statement of Work within
30 days after invoice. Late payments accrue interest at 1.5 percent per month.
3. TERM AND TERMINATION. The term begins on the effective date and continues for 12
months. Either party may terminate for convenience with 90 days written notice.

4. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY. Provider retains all rights in its software, tools, and
preexisting materials. Customer receives a limited license to use the deliverables
during the term.

--- Page 2 ---
5. CONFIDENTIALITY. Each party will protect the other's confidential information using
reasonable care and will not disclose it without prior written consent.
6. WARRANTIES. Provider warrants that the services will be performed in a professional
manner. Customer warrants that it has authority to enter this agreement.
7. DISCLAIMER. Except as stated in this agreement, all services and deliverables are
provided as is without warranties of any kind.
8. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY. Neither party will be liable for indirect, incidental,
special, or consequential damages. Each party's total liability is limited to fees
paid in the prior 12 months.
9. INDEMNIFICATION. Provider will indemnify Customer against third party claims
alleging that the deliverables infringe intellectual property rights. Customer will
indemnify Provider against claims arising from Customer data.
10. DATA PROTECTION. Each party will process personal data in accordance with
applicable law and maintain reasonable administrative, technical, and physical
safeguards.

--- Page 3 ---
11. GOVERNING LAW. This agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Delaware
without regard to conflict of law rules.
12. DISPUTE RESOLUTION. The parties will first attempt to resolve disputes through
good faith negotiation. Unresolved disputes will be submitted to binding arbitration
in Wilmington, Delaware.
13. ASSIGNMENT. Neither party may assign this agreement without the other party's
prior written consent, except to an affiliate or in connection with a merger or sale
of substantially all assets.
14. FORCE MAJEURE. Neither party will be liable for delays caused by events beyond its
reasonable control.
15. ENTIRE AGREEMENT. This agreement constitutes the entire understanding and
supersedes all prior agreements.
16. SIGNATURES. The parties execute this agreement by their authorized
representatives.
IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have signed this agreement as of the date first
written above.
